description: This header file provides utility functions and templates for managing smart pointers, including creation, conversion, and traits. It extends the standard <memory> library with additional functionality specific to the Abseil library.

classes.name: memory_internal::ExtractOr
classes.description: A template struct that evaluates to a specific type based on whether a certain template instantiation is valid.

classes.name: memory_internal::ExtractOrT
classes.description: A type alias for extracting a type or defaulting if extraction is not possible.

classes.name: memory_internal::GetIsNothrow
classes.description: A template alias to access the 'is_nothrow' trait of an allocator.

classes.name: absl::allocator_is_nothrow
classes.description: A traits class that determines if an allocator's allocation function never throws.

classes.name: absl::default_allocator_is_nothrow
classes.description: A type indicating whether the default allocator never throws.

methods.name: WrapUnique
methods.description: Wraps a raw pointer into a std::unique_ptr, disallowing arrays and non-object types.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: Alias for std::make_unique, used to create unique_ptr instances.

methods.name: RawPtr
methods.description: Extracts the raw pointer from a pointer-like object.

methods.name: ShareUniquePtr
methods.description: Converts a std::unique_ptr into a std::shared_ptr, transferring ownership.

methods.name: WeakenPtr
methods.description: Creates a std::weak_ptr from a std::shared_ptr.
